Work

A studio debut in progress, and the mobile hit that came before it.

Virdane Labs — in development

Son of Mabin

A 2.5D pixel-art RPG built in Unity, Virdane Labs' debut title. I'm the founder and sole programmer, building the combat and narrative systems from the ground up while the studio works toward a playable MVP.

  • Unity
  • 2.5D pixel art
  • C#
Follow progress on itch.io

Mekan Games — shipped

The President

A hypercasual mobile game I helped ideate, design, develop and ship to over 20M+ combined downloads on Android and iOS, and three 2022 Games Industry Africa Awards: Game of the Year, Most Impactful Video Game, and Debut of the Year.

  • Mobile
  • Hypercasual
